findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "waste_digital_tracking_readiness" stacks urgency/override words (never, mandatory). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

evidence.snippet: FREE DIGITAL WASTE TRACKING RECEIVING-SITE READINESS tool for England phase 1. Select only when the question is whether a waste receiving site is in the permitt…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: waste_permit_change_preflight · Private data: waste_digital_tracking_readiness · Public sink: waste_rule_preflight.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: waste_permit_change_preflight · Private data: waste_digital_tracking_readiness · Public sink: waste_rule_preflight

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
